description:
Dataverse Cartographer draws an interactive map of a Dynamics 365 / Dataverse organization, so that you can understand a data model in minutes, document a solution or a model-driven app, and prepare an impact analysis before a change.

Data model: tables and their 1:N, N:1 and N:N relationships, drawn with crow's-foot notation, cascade-delete relationships in red. Filter by solution, model-driven app, publisher prefix, custom or standard tables, hide system tables and tables without relationships, or keep only the tables that hold at least one active record. Explore the neighbors of one table up to 6 levels deep, click the legend to hide a category, and hover any table or relationship for a precise card (lookup column, full cascade behavior, record count). The table card lists the columns, relationships, alternate keys, forms, the JavaScript handlers of every form and the registered plugin steps.

Plugins: a technical map that reads as a chain, table -> step -> plugin -> what its code does -> table (for example, the PostCreate of a contact updates the account). The tables touched by each plugin are found by a static analysis of the assembly stored in the organization (or inside the plugin package), which is read without being loaded. Filter by solution or by assembly (DLL).

JavaScript: the same chain for the form scripts, table -> form events -> library -> Xrm.WebApi / Web API calls -> table, with the function and line of each call. Filter by solution or by library.

Every map can be exported as PNG, SVG, Mermaid, PlantUML or an Excel inventory. Four automatic layouts, search, zoom and pan. Read only: nothing is written to the organization. A connection is required. English and French interface.
releaseNotes:
1.0.0 - First release

- Interactive map of the tables and their 1:N, N:1 and N:N relationships: zoom, pan, move tables, four layouts (hierarchical, force-directed, circular / radial, grid), edges bent around tables.
- Crow's-foot notation, N:N relationships dashed, cascade-delete relationships in red.
- Filters by solution, model-driven app, publisher prefix, custom / standard tables; hide system tables and tables without relationships; show or hide N:N and self-references.
- Option to keep only the tables with at least one active record, checked on the server once per connection after a confirmation.
- Exploration of the neighbors of a table (1 to 6 levels), with the linked tables outside the filters shown faded.
- Clickable legend to hide or show a category of tables or relationships.
- Hover cards on tables and relationships: lookup and referenced columns, cascade behavior, record count.
- Table card with columns, relationships, alternate keys, forms, JavaScript handlers of every form and registered plugin steps.
- Plugin map (table, step, plugin, table) with a static analysis of the plugin assemblies to find the tables each plugin creates, updates, deletes or reads; filters by solution and assembly.
- JavaScript map (table, form events, library, table) with the Xrm.WebApi, Web API, FetchXML and navigation calls of each script, their function and line; filters by solution and library.
- Search for a table or a column, and exploration from the search box.
- Exports: PNG and SVG (whole map with a title), Mermaid and PlantUML (file or clipboard), Excel inventory.
- Loading screen with progress, modern dialogs, English and French interface, settings remembered between sessions.
summary: Interactive map of a Dataverse organization: tables and relationships by solution or model-driven app, which plugins and form scripts touch which tables, with PNG / SVG / Mermaid / Excel export.
title: Dataverse Cartographer
